title: the project on events, decisions and pull request sync
acceptance: Implements design.md section 15.4 for the log and decisions. fm-emit.sh accepts --project, validates it against the registry (exit 65 when unknown) and writes a top-level `project` field; an event without it belongs to the default project, and existing log lines stay valid. The new event types spec_pinned and spec_repinned are accepted and listed in section 5.1.

Captain decision D-1015 = A replaces the decision-id scheme of design.md sections 15.4 and 15.10 point 1. Every new decision id names its owner: D-<project>-<task>-<n>, for example D-firstmate-workflow-T047-1. <project> is the resolved project's registry name (T-046: explicit flag, then FM_PROJECT, then the default). <task> is the task id without its hyphen (T047). <n> starts at 1 and counts only within that project's task, allocated by fm-decide.sh as the next free n under that task's own lock. No global counter and no cross-project or cross-task lock exist. fm-run.sh raises merge cards in this form and never derives D-<task digits> again. Hand-raised cards use the same form. Existing ids (D-<digits>, D-SK-<n>) stay valid wherever they are read and are never renamed or moved; T-056's renumbering (§15.10's store list, the renumber map, --renumber) is dropped. design.md §15.4 and §15.10 are rewritten to this rule, and T-054's acceptance loses its id-map work, since nothing is renumbered. Every parser of decision ids accepts the new form alongside the old: fm-decide.sh (lines 45, 89, 125, 152), board/server.ts (response listing at :128 and the decision route at :545), board/public/diagram.js:18, index.html where it reads ids, fm-diagram.sh's is_decision_id, and the file names of every decision-keyed store. The board shows project and task parsed from the id.

Tests written to fail first: the same task id in two projects yields two distinct ids; two cards for one task get n=1 and n=2; two tasks never share an id; with the old hand-raised record D-056 (for T-043) present, a new merge card for T-056 is raised as D-firstmate-workflow-T056-1 and nothing old is read, moved or overwritten; every parser listed above accepts both forms and rejects malformed ones (bad project name, missing task, n of 0, path characters); the board lists, answers and renders diagrams for a new-form card, in board.test.sh and the e2e spec.

fm-sync-prs.sh polls every registered project's github repository (gh --repo) and emits with that project; fm-merge.sh takes --project and merges on that project's repository. (project, pr) is the key: a pull request number in one project never matches an event of another.
Self-hosting keeps working after this task alone: with no --project, and with the firstmate-workflow project named explicitly, every existing caller, fixture and test behaves as before.

Captain decision D-1023 = A: tests/option-loop.test.sh joins this scope only to update three pinned counts of value-taking flags: fm-decide 9 to 10, fm-emit 7 to 8 and fm-merge 3 to 4, one each for --project.
Evidence is this pull request's required GitHub check and the seven gates. New behaviour gets tests written to fail first; the worker does not run the suite itself.
Stay inside this scope. If the work needs a file outside it, stop and name the file and the reason.
